capture.normalized_excerpt_hashes: SHA-256 over the exact visible excerpt strings recorded below; these are not raw-response hashes.
capture.limitation: Browser-rendered source text was available, but raw HTTP bodies and exact per-request retrieval timestamps were not. The vote pages are time-bounded snapshots, not a synchronized forecast feature.
capture.copyright_note: Source preservation uses short identifying excerpts (within quotation limits) plus original paraphrased summaries; hashes cover the short excerpts, not raw HTTP bytes.

executive_findings: XRPLWin's current pages show LendingProtocol 21/35, SingleAssetVault 23/35 and LendingProtocolV1_1 21/35; each remains below the 29-vote threshold and has not entered a majority countdown.

A separate xrpl.to page snapshot dated 2026-11-07 reports 36 trusted validators with the same yes-vote counts and 29 required. The denominator conflict is unresolved; neither tracker is treated as a canonical global trusted set.
The 2026-11-06 XRPLWin snapshot also showed 21/35, 23/35 and 21/35. The current XRPLWin counts therefore do not demonstrate an increase in yes votes.

fixCleanup3_4_0 was enabled on 2026-11-04 at 14:52 UTC, ledger 108112129. It repairs safety/correctness behavior in lending/vault code but does not activate LendingProtocol, SingleAssetVault or LendingProtocolV1_1.
XLS-66 lending is explicitly uncollateralized and funded from pooled Single Asset Vault assets, with off-chain underwriting. Vault deposits are funder capital, not borrower collateral.
No actual vault capital, loan origination, borrower repayment/default, XRP collateral balance or XRP settlement volume was verified.

source_independence_and_disagreement.denominator_disagreement: XRPLWin reports 35 trusted validators; XRPL.to reports 36. Both show the same yes counts and 29 required. The trusted-set difference is unresolved.
source_independence_and_disagreement.independence: XRPLWin and secondary articles that cite XRPLWin are not counted as independent confirmations. XRPL.to is kept as a separate dashboard source, but its API was not tested and its 36-validator denominator is not promoted to canonical.
source_independence_and_disagreement.robust_conclusion: All reported vote counts are below the 29-vote supermajority threshold; the exact denominator does not change that conclusion.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The XRPL native lending stack may eventually create a new market for fixed-term credit funded by pooled vault assets.
supporting: Official XLS-66/XLS-65 design and the continuing validator vote process.
disconfirming: All three required amendments remain below supermajority.
Loans are uncollateralized and depend on off-chain underwriting.
No live vault balances, originations, repayments or defaults are verified.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Protocol-safety progress may be mistaken for immediate lending activation or XRP collateral demand.
supporting: fixCleanup3_4_0 is enabled and repairs vault/lending code paths.
LendingProtocol, SingleAssetVault and LendingProtocolV1_1 remain open for voting below threshold.
disconfirming: Future validator support may change; this is a time-bounded state assessment.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The 35-versus-36 validator denominator discrepancy reflects differing trusted-validator sets or tracker methodology rather than a change in yes votes.
supporting: XRPLWin and XRPL.to show identical yes counts but different denominators.
disconfirming: No common canonical validator-set manifest was retrieved to reconcile the discrepancy.

model_ineligibility_reasons: Vote snapshots are not price features and do not measure capital, collateral or market demand.
Exact retrieval timestamps/raw response bytes were unavailable.
No historical point-in-time vote series was collected.
No out-of-sample price test establishes predictive value.
